name: file_search
description: Search across OpenAI vector stores via the provider's built-in file_search tool. This is a provider-native tool executed server-side by OpenAI's Responses API (Codex OAuth / OpenAI Responses provider). Enable it by listing `file_search` in your agent's tools.md. At least one vector store id must be passed through when the agent's tool config builds the request — see agent docs.

vector_store_ids.description: OpenAI vector store IDs to search against. Pass via the agent config's built-in tool settings; the LLM does NOT supply this itself.
